name: What materials are best for an accessible bathroom to ensure safety and durability?
description: Best materials include slip-resistant flooring, durable and easy-to-clean surfaces, robust grab bars, and lever-style faucets for safety and durability.

mainEntity.name: What materials are best for an accessible bathroom to ensure safety and durability?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an accessible bathroom, prioritizing materials that enhance safety and durability is key. This includes slip-resistant flooring options like textured tiles or vinyl, and durable, easy-to-clean surfaces for countertops and showers, such as solid-surface materials or large-format tiles to minimize grout lines. High-quality grab bars made from stainless steel or other robust materials are essential. When selecting fixtures, consider lever-style faucets and comfort-height toilets for ease of use. Frasheski Construction advises on material selections that meet both aesthetic and functional requirements for longevity.
